requirement.en: During a turn you have not activated "Final Ritual of the Ancients".

effect.en: Ritual Summon "Reshef the Dark Being" by sending monsters from your hand or field to the Graveyard whose total Levels equal 8 or more as material (you cannot use more monsters than necessary as material).
